samples_reviewed.question_text: The two parts are 1620 and 2356. What is the sum?
Rico solved: "1640 + 3900 = ___". Rico says the missing number is 5540. Is Rico correct?
The dot is at 9090 and it moves forward 310 numbers. Starting from 9090, just count up 310 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
The dot is at 3622 and it moves forward 5280 numbers. Starting from 3622, just count up 5280 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
Dante solved: "6338 + 1914 = ___". Dante says the missing number is 8252. Is Dante correct?
Pia has 4860 water bowls. A friend has 5100 water bowls. If they put all their water bowls together, how many water bowls do they have in all?
The dot is at 8511 and it moves forward 1489 numbers. Starting from 8511, just count up 1489 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
The two parts are 2285 and 3504. What is the sum?
The dot is at 6459 and it moves forward 693 numbers. Starting from 6459, just count up 693 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Sums are what is computed and the arithmetic checks out across the set, including the boundary case where 8511 plus 1489 is keyed at exactly 10000. Part-part-whole phrasing about two parts and a sum names the operation in the language of the objective.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Both halves of the regrouping clause turn up: the pair 2285 and 3504 needs no carrying in any column, while cases such as 8506 plus 218 and 3583 plus 586 do. Addend sizes also vary from a single-digit 2 up to four digits.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The number-line items tell the pupil to count on by ones across jumps of thousands, as in the stem where the dot is at 3622 and moves forward 5280 numbers. Instructing a Grade 3 child to just count up 5280 numbers is not a method anyone can carry out, and it contradicts the column addition the node is meant to build.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Six shells are in play: a bare equation, a part-and-sum statement, an error check on a classmate's work, a truth judgment, a number-line representation, and one collection context. That is ample presentation range for a computation objective.

competency_alignment.rationale: Harder samples differ from easier ones by digit count and by how many columns carry, which is the progression this addition objective is about rather than some unrelated dressing.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: No sum exceeds 10 000 and one lands on it precisely, so the ceiling is probed without being broken, and the low end reaches down to a three-digit pair such as 720 and 310.
